attack_mechanism: An internal probe of `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.N` during a chosen MOV, logical, add, or shift operation reveals R4 directly or as a known reversible function. This behavior is connected through `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.r4 -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.reg_src -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.op_src_in_jmp -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.alu_out_nxt -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.N`. `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.N` is an operand, result, or status-producing intermediate reached while the active mux/state branches are selected by `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.src_reg_src_sel`, `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.alu_0.inst_bw`. When the instruction decoder selects R4 as `reg_src` or `reg_dest`, the execution unit presents its value to the ALU operand network. The observation bypasses direct protection of R4; even a one-bit flag leaks a predicate that can be accumulated over chosen operations.
